notes: Identity evidence is separate from editorial near-access coordinate seeds. Seeds are snapped once to the car graph by the cached comparison table, then frozen; no beach driving, parking, swimming-safety or current-access claim.

sources.title: Maharashtra Maritime Board: Shoreline Management Plan 2017
sources.description: Separate named coastal beach inventory and district maps identify Nagaon C75, Akshi C76, Revdanda C74, Korlai C73, Ladghar B57, Devgad A29 and Kunkeshwar A26; geographic identity only. Ladghar is separate from Karde B58 and Murud Dapoli B59.

sources.title: Konkan Divisional Commissioner: Harne and Murud
sources.description: Harnai shore in Dapoli taluka, Ratnagiri; not Murud-Janjira in Raigad.

sources.title: Konkan Divisional Commissioner: Bhatye Beach
sources.description: Identifies Bhatye beach beside Ratnagiri town.

sources.title: Maharashtra Tourism: Kelashi beach and village
sources.description: Identifies Kelashi/Kelshi as one beach in Dapoli taluka, Ratnagiri.

sources.title: Ratnagiri district: tourism inventory
sources.description: District inventory locates Ladghar, Kelshi and Harnai in Dapoli, and Bhatye in Ratnagiri.

sources.title: Maharashtra Tourism: Sindhudurg
sources.description: Identifies Devgad beach and distinguishes it from Kunkeshwar to its south.

sources.title: Ministry of Tourism Incredible India: Goa coastline
sources.description: Identifies Querim/Keri as one beach, Mandrem, Candolim, Benaulim and Varca; identities only, no safety endorsements adopted.

sources.title: Government of Goa: Beaches
sources.description: Distinguishes Candolim and Morjim in north Goa, and Benaulim and Varca in south Goa.
